title: The Cutty Sark
question: What piece of bad luck prevented the Cutty Sark from winning the race?

meanings.usage: 指利用风力推动船只行驶的活动或方式
正式用语，指大型船只或容器
描述给人留下深刻印象的事物
使某人想起某事的事物
指代代相传的风俗或习惯
指历史上具有特征的时期
表示在质量或能力上相当
指控制船只或车辆的方向
船上用于控制方向的装置
强调规模或程度非常大
指事情被推迟或延误的状态
指值得注意的、不寻常的
地球南北之间的假想线

phrases.usage: 出发；启程，指开始一段旅程

examples.en: Both ships set out from Shanghai on June 18th, 1872.
examples.zh: 两艘船于1872年6月18日从上海出发。

examples.en: On the Indian Ocean, the Cutty Sark took the lead.
examples.zh: 在印度洋上，卡蒂萨克号取得了领先。

phrases.usage: 被击中；遭受，指突然遭遇不好的事情

examples.en: In August, she was struck by a very heavy storm.
examples.zh: 八月，她遭遇了一场猛烈的暴风雨。

examples.en: Because of this, the Cutty Sark lost her lead.
examples.zh: 因此，卡蒂萨克号失去了领先地位。

phrases.usage: （船等）停靠，指在某个港口停留

examples.en: The captain called in at a port to have a new rudder fitted.
examples.zh: 船长将船停靠在一个港口，让工人安装新舵。

phrases.usage: 左右摇晃，形容船只不稳地晃动

examples.en: The Cutty Sark rolled from side to side and it became impossible to steer her.
examples.zh: 卡蒂萨克号左右摇晃，变得无法操控。

phrases.usage: 困难地安装，形容做某事很艰难

examples.en: A temporary rudder was made and it was fitted with great difficulty.
examples.zh: 一个临时舵被制造出来，但安装得非常困难。

phrases.usage: 毫无疑问...，用于强调确信某事

examples.en: There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，如果她没有失去舵，她会轻松赢得比赛。

examples.en: Her rudder was torn away.
examples.zh: 她的舵被撕裂了。

examples.en: Before they were replaced by steamships, sailing vessels were used to carry tea.
examples.zh: 在被汽船取代之前，帆船被用来运茶。

sentences.en: One of the most famous sailing ships of the nineteenth century, the Cutty Sark, can still be seen at Greenwich.
sentences.zh: 19世纪最著名的帆船之一，“卡蒂萨克”号至今仍可在格林威治见到。

sentences.en: She stands on dry land and is visited by thousands of people each year.
sentences.zh: 她停泊在陆地上，每年都有成千上万的人参观。

sentences.en: She serves as an impressive reminder of the great ships of the past.
sentences.zh: 她作为对过去伟大船只的深刻纪念。

sentences.en: Before they were replaced by steamships,
sentences.zh: 在它们被蒸汽船取代之前，

sentences.en: sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia.
sentences.zh: 像卡蒂萨克号这样的帆船被用来从中国运茶，从澳大利亚运羊毛。

sentences.en: The Cutty Sark was one of the fastest sailing ships that has ever been built.
sentences.zh: 卡蒂萨克号是建造过的最快的帆船之一。

sentences.en: The only other ship to match her was the Thermopylae.
sentences.zh: 唯一能与她匹敌的船是“特莫皮莱”号。

sentences.en: Both these ships set out from Shanghai on June 18th, 1872 on an exciting race to England.
sentences.zh: 这两艘船于1872年6月18日从上海启程，进行一场激动人心的英国竞赛。

sentences.en: This race, which went on for exactly four months, was the last of its kind.
sentences.zh: 这场持续了整整四个月的比赛是同类比赛中的最后一场。

sentences.en: It marked the end of the great tradition of ships with sails and the beginning of a new era.
sentences.zh: 它标志着帆船伟大传统的结束和新时代的开始。

sentences.en: The first of the two ships to reach Java after the race had begun was the Thermopylae,
sentences.zh: 比赛开始后，两艘船中最先抵达爪哇的是“特莫皮莱”号，

sentences.en: but on the Indian Ocean, the Cutty Sark took the lead.
sentences.zh: 但在印度洋上，“卡蒂萨克”号取得了领先。

sentences.en: It seemed certain that she would be the first ship home,
sentences.zh: 似乎她肯定会是第一艘抵达的船，

sentences.en: but during the race she had a lot of bad luck.
sentences.zh: 但在比赛中她遭遇了很多厄运。

sentences.en: In August, she was struck by a very heavy storm during which her rudder was torn away.
sentences.zh: 八月，她遭遇了一场特大风暴，船舵被刮走了。

sentences.en: The Cutty Sark rolled from side to side and it became impossible to steer her.
sentences.zh: 卡蒂萨克号左右摇晃，无法掌舵。

sentences.en: A temporary rudder was made on board from spare planks and it was fitted with great difficulty.
sentences.zh: 船上用备用木板做了一个临时船舵，并费了很大力气才安装好。

sentences.en: This greatly reduced the speed of the ship, for there was a danger that if she travelled too quickly,
sentences.zh: 这大大降低了船速，因为存在一个危险，如果她航行过快，

sentences.en: this rudder would be torn away as well.
sentences.zh: 这个船舵也会被刮走。

sentences.en: Because of this, the Cutty Sark lost her lead.
sentences.zh: 因此，卡蒂萨克号失去了领先地位。

sentences.en: After crossing the Equator, the captain called in at a port to have a new rudder fitted,
sentences.zh: 越过赤道后，船长在一个港口停靠，安装了一个新船舵，

sentences.en: but by now the Thermopylae was over five hundred miles ahead.
sentences.zh: 但此时“特莫皮莱”号已经领先五百多英里了。

sentences.en: Though the new rudder was fitted at tremendous speed, it was impossible for the Cutty Sark to win.
sentences.zh: 尽管新船舵以惊人的速度安装好了，卡蒂萨克号还是不可能赢得比赛。

sentences.en: She arrived in England a week after the Thermopylae.
sentences.zh: 她在“特莫皮莱”号之后一周抵达英国。

sentences.en: Even this was remarkable, considering that she had had so many delays.
sentences.zh: 考虑到她有如此多的延误，即使这样也值得称赞。

sentences.en: There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，如果她没有失去船舵，她会轻易赢得比赛。

但在印度洋上，“卡蒂萨克”号取得了领先。
她曾告诉他，如果她没有开门，他就直接进来，把面包放在厨房的桌子上。
exercises.explain: but on the Indian Ocean, the Cutty Sark took the lead. — 但在印度洋上，“卡蒂萨克”号取得了领先。

source.en: but on the Indian Ocean, the Cutty Sark took the lead.

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个时间点之前已经完成的动作或状态，常与一般过去时连用
grammar.usage: 用于描述发生在过去之前的事件，常用于复合句中

examples.en: The first of the two ships to reach Java after the race had begun was the Thermopylae.
examples.zh: 比赛开始后，第一艘到达爪哇的船是Thermopylae号。

examples.en: She had had many delays before arriving in England.
examples.zh: 她在到达英国之前经历了许多延误。

grammar.title: 虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood) - 与过去事实相反
grammar.definition: 用来表达与事实相反的假设或不可能发生的情况
grammar.structure: if + 主语 + had + 过去分词, 主语 + would/could/might have + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于谈论与过去事实相反的假设

examples.en: If she had not lost her rudder, she would have won the race easily.
examples.zh: 如果她没有失去舵，她本会轻松赢得比赛。

examples.en: If it had not rained, we would have gone out.
examples.zh: 如果没有下雨，我们本会出去。

grammar.title: 过去分词作定语 (Past Participle as Adjective)
grammar.definition: 过去分词可用作形容词，修饰名词，表示被动或完成的意义
grammar.structure: 过去分词 + 名词 或 名词 + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于简化定语从句，使句子更简洁

examples.en: The only other ship to match her was the Thermopylae.
examples.zh: 唯一能与她匹敌的另一艘船是Thermopylae号。

examples.en: She serves as an impressive reminder of the great ships of the past.
examples.zh: 她作为一个令人印象深刻的纪念物，提醒人们过去伟大的船只。

original.en: It seemed certain that she would be the first ship home.
original.zh: 她似乎是第一个到达的船，这似乎是确定的。

examples.en: It seemed certain that he would pass the exam.
examples.zh: 他似乎一定会通过考试。

examples.en: It seemed certain that our team would win the match.
examples.zh: 我们队似乎一定会赢得比赛。

original.en: There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.
original.zh: 毫无疑问，如果她没有失去舵，她会轻松赢得比赛。

examples.en: There is no doubt that hard work leads to success.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，努力工作会带来成功。

examples.en: There is no doubt that she is the best student in the class.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，她是班上最好的学生。

patterns.pattern: The only other...to do something was...

original.en: The only other ship to match her was the Thermopylae.
original.zh: 唯一能与她匹敌的另一艘船是Thermopylae号。

examples.en: The only other student to finish the test early was Tom.
examples.zh: 唯一另一个提前完成考试的学生是汤姆。

examples.en: The only other country to win the championship three times was Brazil.
examples.zh: 唯一另一个三次赢得冠军的国家是巴西。

original.en: Because of this, the Cutty Sark lost her lead.
original.zh: 因此，卡蒂萨克号失去了领先地位。

examples.en: Because of this, he decided to change his major.
examples.zh: 因此，他决定换专业。

examples.en: Because of the heavy traffic, we arrived late.
examples.zh: 因为交通拥堵，我们迟到了。
